certification.rule: a flag is a read-only check when the first word of its prose is one of list/show/print/display/test/check/verify/give and it takes no argument

citation.what_compile_step_attaches: page['checks'][0] -- the alphabetically first flag the shipped rule certified
citation.why_not: goal_holds() runs its own named programs; the published check is a receipt field only

repair.rule: RULE_RUN: the shipped rule, plus not a destroyer by name, not a write by the page's own vocabulary, and changes no bytes when actually run

effect_on_the_shipped_round.note: the citation is a field on the receipt and is never read by edges_of or by goal_holds, so a repaired citation changes what the round CLAIMS and no number it computes -- which is exactly why the defect could persist

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark result: one machine, 446 pages, a handful of artifact kinds
not a claim that the shipped round's eleven needs were wrong: every goal in it is checked by goal_holds(), which does run programs. The finding is about the citation
not a claim that an executed check would have caught a bad step here: none of the eleven needs took a wrong object, so the blindness is latent and measured on a room built to expose it
not a blacklist: naming shred and split would fail on the next machine, which is why the rule is execution plus the page's own vocabulary
limits: the which-object probes are four artifact kinds read from this machine's pages; a kind with no decoy here is not measured
a check that changes no bytes and accepts a decoy is BLIND, not wrong: it is a validity test, and the honest repair is to stop calling it a verification
the repaired rule is measured on this machine's pages; its behaviour on a machine whose pages print different vocabulary is not measured

shipped_round.what_it_is: the round that owns the code this round repaired, re-run after the repair and recorded here need for need so a second machine can compare it
shipped_round.why_it_did_not_move: the citation this round repaired is a receipt field that neither edges_of() nor goal_holds() reads, which is why the defect could persist
